name: Roy Wang
headline: AI Engineer & Product Builder
tagline: Building AI-native consumer products, agents and interactive experiences.
about: Graduated from National Taiwan Normal University (B.S., Learning Sciences, 2026). My HCI background shapes how I approach the interaction between people and complex systems.
I build AI-powered tools and interactive experiences across agent systems, full-stack interfaces, creative technology and applied NLP research.
My direction is AI-native consumer products: I want to build products people use, return to, and choose to pay for. This is a product goal, not a claim of current users or revenue.

review.basis: Migrated existing public profile and portfolio; not a new owner attestation.
